summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the transformer-component node into a compact US-listed universe. The strongest direct public-market mappings found in this pass are Hubbell for transformer bushings and related utility apparatus, DuPont for Nomex transformer insulation, Cleveland-Cliffs for grain-oriented electrical steel exposure to transformer cores, and Hammond Power Solutions as an OTC-listed transformer OEM/direct customer anchor with possible component-chain sensitivity. Evidence quality is mixed: Hubbell and DuPont have direct product-page evidence; Cleveland-Cliffs has annual-report evidence for transformer/electrical-steel linkage but requires product-mix verification; Hammond is included as a speculative OTC exception based on external context and should be verified with primary filings. Layer 1B expansion found a small US-listed universe with plausible transformer-component or adjacent grid-hardware exposure. The cleanest direct public-market mappings are Hubbell for bushings/arresters/insulators and Cleveland-Cliffs for grain-oriented electrical steel used in transformer cores. Worthington Steel is a lower-attention candidate via electrical steel laminations and processing, but its exact transformer-core revenue exposure needs verification. Preformed Line Products is not a transformer-component supplier, but is included as an underfollowed adjacent transmission-hardware beneficiary that may surface when transformer bottlenecks migrate into broader substation and line-build procurement.
